analysis.purpose: The `crib` command-line entry point: wraps the indexing pipeline and the MCP server, and resolves which project a command applies to through an explicit priority chain so one user-scoped IDE entry can serve every repository.
responsibilities: Expose index, update, query, serve, doctor, memory and enrichment commands
Resolve the project root by argument, env var, upward walk, then cwd
Register indexed projects so later commands and IDE clients can find them
Return distinct exit codes for error, bad arguments, and not-indexed

businessRules.rule: Read commands walk upward to find .crib, but index and reindex target exactly the directory given.
businessRules.rationale: Indexing the wrong directory by accident is far more damaging than failing to find one.

businessRules.rule: Not-indexed is its own exit code, distinct from a general error.
businessRules.rationale: Lets a caller distinguish "run index first" from a real failure.
